"""Run the exact D15 embedded settlement against a private disposable PostgreSQL.
No provider API, production configuration or in-place restore is used.
"""
import asyncio
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from uuid import uuid4
from types import SimpleNamespace

from sqlalchemy import delete, select, text
from sqlalchemy.engine import make_url
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession, async_sessionmaker, create_async_engine
from sqlalchemy.pool import NullPool
from app.db.models import Base, Organization, User, OwnerControlRecord, IdentityMediaExecution, AuditEvent
from app.db import base as db
from app.services import host_maintenance_admission as admission

url=make_url(os.environ["DATABASE_URL"])
assert url.database == "fr06_d15_disposable" and url.host == "fr06-d15-pg"
assert os.environ.get("ENVIRONMENT") == "test"
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("d15", "/qa/scripts/security/fr06c5d15_identity_media_terminal_reconcile.py")
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
program=m.SETTLE.rsplit("asyncio.run(main())",1)[0]
appname="fr06-d15-lab-"+uuid4().hex
engine=create_async_engine(url, poolclass=NullPool, connect_args={"server_settings":{"application_name":appname}})
sessions=async_sessionmaker(engine, expire_on_commit=False)
db.SessionLocal=sessions
operation=str(uuid4()); control_id=str(uuid4()); org=str(uuid4()); user=str(uuid4())
admission.RESOURCE_ID="d15-disposable-"+uuid4().hex
job="synthetic-job"; jobhash=hashlib.sha256(job.encode()).hexdigest()
accepted=[]

async def seed_authority(*, gen=41, op=operation, status="closed"):
    async with sessions() as s, s.begin():
        row=await s.get(OwnerControlRecord,control_id)
        payload=dict(schema_version=8, scope=admission.REALTIME_REQUEST_COVERAGE_SCOPE,
                     generation=gen, operation_id=op, reason="isolated-d15-fixture",
                     changed_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), full_host_closure=False)
        if row is None:
            s.add(OwnerControlRecord(id=control_id,domain=admission.DOMAIN,resource_id=admission.RESOURCE_ID,
                                   status=status,enabled=status=="open",version=gen,payload=payload))
        else:
            row.status=status;row.enabled=status=="open";row.version=gen;row.payload=payload

async def new_execution():
    eid=str(uuid4())
    async with sessions() as s, s.begin():
        s.add(IdentityMediaExecution(id=eid,organization_id=org,requested_by_id=user,
              operation="voice_clone",identity_basis="self",provider_access="test",
              provider="replicate",model="synthetic-not-a-provider-model",status="failed",
              provider_state="starting",idempotency_key=eid,subject_reference="synthetic-self",
              provider_job_id=job,completed_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc),version=3))
    return eid

async def invoke(eid):
    prior=sys.argv
    sys.argv=["-c",eid,"3",jobhash,"failed",operation,"41"]
    namespace={}
    try:
        exec(compile(program,"<exact-D15-SETTLE>","exec"),namespace)
        await namespace["main"]()
    finally:sys.argv=prior

async def assert_row(eid, state, version):
    async with sessions() as s:
        row=await s.get(IdentityMediaExecution,eid)
        assert row.status=="failed" and row.provider_state==state and row.version==version
        audits=(await s.scalars(select(AuditEvent).where(AuditEvent.resource_id==eid,
                   AuditEvent.action=="identity_media.execution.provider_terminal_reconciled"))).all()
        assert len(audits)==(1 if state=="failed" else 0)
        if audits:
            assert audits[0].details["maintenance_operation_id"]==operation
            assert audits[0].details["maintenance_generation"]==41

async def main():
    async with engine.begin() as c:await c.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)
    async with sessions() as s,s.begin():
        s.add(Organization(id=org,name="Disposable D15",slug="d15-"+org,status="active",plan="free"))
        await s.flush()
        s.add(User(id=user,organization_id=org,email=user+"@example.invalid",name="Synthetic",
                   password_hash="not-a-login-hash",status="active"))
    for kwargs,label in [({"status":"open"},"open-denied"),({"gen":42},"generation-drift-denied"),
                        ({"op":str(uuid4())},"operation-drift-denied")]:
        await seed_authority(**kwargs);eid=await new_execution()
        try:await invoke(eid)
        except RuntimeError as ex:assert "maintenance authority" in str(ex)
        else:raise AssertionError("authority drift allowed settlement")
        await assert_row(eid,"starting",3);accepted.append(label)
    await seed_authority();eid=await new_execution();await invoke(eid)
    await assert_row(eid,"failed",4);accepted.append("same-authority-commit-and-audit")
    try:await invoke(eid)
    except RuntimeError as ex:assert "baseline changed" in str(ex)
    else:raise AssertionError("same row settlement repeated")
    await assert_row(eid,"failed",4);accepted.append("version-CAS-no-replay")

    await seed_authority();eid=await new_execution()
    acquired=asyncio.Event();release=asyncio.Event()
    class ProbeSession(AsyncSession):
        async def execute(self, stmt, *args, **kwargs):
            result=await super().execute(stmt,*args,**kwargs)
            lock=getattr(stmt,"_for_update_arg",None)
            if lock is not None and lock.read and not self.info.get("paused"):
                self.info["paused"]=True;acquired.set();await release.wait()
            return result
    db.SessionLocal=async_sessionmaker(engine,class_=ProbeSession,expire_on_commit=False)
    writer=asyncio.create_task(invoke(eid));opener=None
    try:
        await asyncio.wait_for(acquired.wait(),10)
        opener=asyncio.create_task(admission.open_admission(operation_id=operation,expected_generation=41,
                      reason="disposable race test",session_factory=sessions))
        blocked=False
        for _ in range(100):
            async with sessions() as monitor:
                count=await monitor.scalar(text("SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE application_name=:n AND wait_event_type='Lock'"),{"n":appname})
            if count:
                blocked=True;break
            await asyncio.sleep(.02)
        assert blocked and not opener.done(),"real PostgreSQL exclusive lock did not wait"
        release.set();await asyncio.wait_for(writer,10)
        opened=await asyncio.wait_for(opener,10)
        assert opened.generation==42 and opened.is_open
        await assert_row(eid,"failed",4);accepted.append("real-PG-reopen-waits-for-settlement-commit")
    finally:
        release.set()
        for task in (writer,opener):
            if task is not None and not task.done():task.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(*(t for t in (writer,opener) if t is not None),return_exceptions=True)
        db.SessionLocal=sessions
    await engine.dispose()
    result=dict(status="PASS",tests=len(accepted),cases=accepted,
                embedded_program_sha256=hashlib.sha256(m.SETTLE.encode()).hexdigest(),
                real_postgresql=True,provider_calls=0,production_changed=False)
    out=Path("/evidence/postgres-result.json")
    with out.open("x") as f:json.dump(result,f,indent=2);f.write("\n")
    print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True))

asyncio.run(main())
